== Summary ==
Gentleman, "97 Star Trek CCG World Champion" and family man David Bowling laughs in the face of adversity. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
